The '''1975–76 season''' was '''[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]'s''' [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|73rd season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time La Liga table|44th consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
The club clinched its [[1975–76 La Liga|17th league title]], finishing five points above runners-up [[FC Barcelona|CF Barcelona]]. Despite Cruijff, Neeskens and Co. having a better offensive line, Real Madrid managed to counterweight that with a brilliant defensive line that ultimately won them the trophy. During the summer, a back up line reinforcement [[Juan Sol]] arrived from [[Valencia CF|Valencia]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://futbol.sportec.es/seleccion/ficha_jugador.asp?j=610&n=sol%2Fjuan%2Fcruz%2Fsol%2Foria|title=Juan Sol|publisher=sportec.es|language=Spanish|access-date=2 July 2020|archive-date=14 October 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091014102625/http://futbol.sportec.es/seleccion/ficha_jugador.asp?j=610&n=sol%2Fjuan%2Fcruz%2Fsol%2Foria|url-status=dead}}</ref> being crucial for the team during the campaign.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ciberche.net/histoche/jugadores/19?pid=249&show_all=1|title=Sol and Valencia|language=Spanish|access-date=2 July 2020|publisher=ciberche.net|archive-date=20 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201120050136/http://www.ciberche.net/histoche/jugadores/19?pid=249&show_all=1|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In the [[1975–76 European Cup|European Cup]], the squad reached the semi-finals, losing the tie against back-to-back Champions [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/bundesliga/2020/06/17/5ee29f83ca474183108b45ac.html|title=History of Bayern München in Ten Moments|publisher=Diario Marca|date=1 June 2020|access-date=2 July 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> The club was eliminated early in the [[1975–76 Copa del Generalísimo|Copa del Generalísimo]] round of 16 by underdogs [[CD Tenerife]], despite playing the decisive match at the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eldiario.es/canariasahora/Deportes/increible-ko-cd-tenerife-real-madrid-futbol-copa-del-generalisimo_1_5969842.html|title=The Incredible KO of Tenerife against Real Madrid|publisher=eldiario.es|language=Spanish|access-date=2 July 2020}}</ref>
